newsitem.title: USA: Town & Country not assured of continued listing.
newsitem.headline: Town & Country not assured of continued listing.

text.p: Town & Country Corp said Thursday that it is being reviewed by the American Stock Exchange for continued listing status.
The company said there is no assurance that its listing will be continued.
Earlier, the company reported a first quarter loss of $0.12 a share on $33 million in net sales, down from the $0.09 loss on $58.3 million in net sales it reported a year-earlier.
The company said year-to-year comparisons were affected by the sale of its Balfour unit.
